title: About us
excerpt: CXO Matters delivers the latest information through blogs and resources for the tech, business, finance, sales and marketing, and media and entertainment industries.  We cover recent stories in a variety of formats including: Our Editorial Mission  At CXO Matters, these seven ethics are what we stand for and something we continue to strive for: Our […]
content:
CXO Matters delivers the latest information through blogs and resources for the tech, business, finance, sales and marketing, and media and entertainment industries. 

We cover recent stories in a variety of formats including:

  • Whitepapers
  • eBooks
  • Infographics
  • Reports
  • Blogs

Our Editorial Mission 

At CXO Matters, these seven ethics are what we stand for and something we continue to strive for:

  • Productivity
  • Creativity
  • Intelligence
  • Honesty
  • Communication
  • Reliability
  • Passion

Our Vision 

The most important thing to us is reader trust. We also invite readers to fact-check our pieces, which carefully outline the time, logic, and energy we spent researching, interviewing experts and testing gear. Often, this takes dozens—sometimes even hundreds—of hours.
